commits.subject: chore(ajc): a scratch probe outside the project root dodged all five ignore patterns
commits.summary:
**Third recurrence of the failure the block itself describes.** `AlgebraicJacobian/Albanese/ZScratchCompose.lean` matched none of `*Probe*` / `*probe*` / `/probe_*` / `/scratch_*` / `/Scratch_*` — no "probe" substring, and the two `Scratch` patterns are root-anchored and require an underscore. It was swept into HEAD by commit 7223f5b92, another lanes integrate sweep, which is precisely the phantom-staged-deletion hazard the comment block warns about.

**Fix is unanchored + case-split, matching the `Probe` pairs shape:** added `*Scratch*.lean` and `*scratch*.lean`. Verified the probe is now matched and that no real library file under `AlgebraicJacobian/` is caught. Gitignore does not untrack what is already in HEAD, so the tracked blob still needs `git rm --cached` from its owning lane (ajc-fbc) — filed as an inbox issue rather than done here.
